assign.outcome:
**Six additions across the two experiences, every one proven headless.**

![the second ending](shots/keep-ending-long.png)

**The world** — [/imagine/game/](/imagine/game/)

- [**A Journal column**](/imagine/game/journal/) recounting the run in order. It is the one thing here that is *stored* rather than derived — the HUD, the map and the finale all count the same sets, but the order is gone the instant it happens, so a line is written at the moment of the move. A full run writes 14.
- [**A secret at the Bone Kiln**](/imagine/game/hollow/kiln/) — a fourth verb, `look`, readable only with the ground lens won at the *top of the Spire*. The one route to it is back **down** a realm you already emptied, which is what the map in the rail was always for. It says nothing at all until you carry the lens, so a first pass is unchanged.
- [**A second ending**](/imagine/game/end/) the secret unlocks — *the long way round*. Same chain, better informed. Measured: `9/9 · 3/3 · 3 · 1 · lit · read`.
- **Realm ambiance** — one rung of the `--wash` / `--tint` / `--surface` ladder and one word per realm. Which rung is not taste: it is [vary/tone/up/](/imagine/vary/tone/up/)'s measured verdict. The Hollow is under the hill so it is the floor `#f2f2f2`, the Verge `#f8f8f8`, the Spire `#ffffff`.
- **Fixed:** the map and the rail disagreed after a trade — a re-locked Cistern drew as a bright link while the row beside it said *needs the brass lamp*.

**The team** — [/imagine/team/](/imagine/team/)

- **Drag a chip between lanes.** `ext/Draggable` reused (not `Sortable` — a lane is not an ordered list and a task is not an Item), committing through the same `assign_lane()` the person's buttons call, so there is one writer and a drag cannot drift from a click. Queued `10 pts / 3` → `8 / 2`, Landed `5 / 3` → `7 / 4`; it survives a reload and Escape commits nothing.
- **Lane point totals**, and a **capacity bar** in the roster with a real denominator (the biggest open load on the team, so the fullest row is full and the rest are drawn to scale). The rail head said *1 of 6* while all six rows were on screen — it now says `25 pts open`, which the six bars are fractions of.

**Proven** — 400 / 1920 / 3440 all `scrollWidth == clientWidth`, zero console errors, and the three named regressions hold: the trade still moves two rail rows in opposite directions (and now arms a third), the finale numbers are still exact, the board still follows the topic.

**Read:** [game/readme.md](/imagine/game/readme/) · [game/doc/decisions.md](/imagine/game/doc/decisions.md) (round 3) · [imagine/readme.md](/imagine/readme/)

**The trap, written down:** `Draggable.under()` returns the first *registered* thing under the cursor — and every chip is registered too, so a drop onto a lane that already held a card handed back that **card**, whose `lane` is undefined. The gesture looked perfect and committed nothing.

**Left:** a confirm before *start over* erases a run; add-a-task from the board; a warn-tint on an overloaded lane; keyboard travel in both. **Cut:** filter chips on the board — the roster already filters by person, and a second device saying one thing is the house defect. A third and fourth ending off the lantern — two booleans is four screens nobody reads.
